invalidation_condition: If Initial Jobless Claims come in significantly higher than consensus or if the DXY shows strong upward momentum.
stage_reason: Anticipated positive surprise in Initial Jobless Claims (lower than consensus) indicating labor market resilience, which could put downward pressure on USD/JPY as it might reduce immediate Fed rate cut expectations. DXY was down yesterday. Treasury yields also fell.

invalidation_condition: If US Treasury yields reverse sharply upwards or if there is any unexpected hawkish commentary from Fed officials.
stage_reason: Continued reaction to labor data and potential follow-through from earlier moves. Mixed regional Fed survey data (Philly Fed manufacturing index showing decline) may limit further USD strength.

invalidation_condition: Breakout in either direction with significant volume and conviction.
stage_reason: Market consolidates ahead of further data or potential shifts in sentiment. Volatility may decrease as initial reactions fade. Uncertainty about economic growth outlook persists.

invalidation_condition: If any new dovish signals emerge regarding Fed policy or if risk-off sentiment intensifies.
stage_reason: Potential for a short-covering rally or a reassessment of the economic outlook. If the market interprets earlier data as a sign of a soft landing rather than a slowdown, USD/JPY could recover. Housing starts data showed a MoM increase.
